# Types

Every type the API sends and receives: 519 in all. Each page lists its fields (or values), shows an
example, and links to the calls and types that use it.

| Type | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`AddMessageResult`](types/add-message-result.md) | object | What happened to a message you sent to an interaction run: whether the run was waiting for it, and where it sits in the conversation. |
